items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Fields was a good one, too. George Fields.

ctx.x: George Fields was a good one, too. George Fields. Uh, let me see. And another boy, uh... Akin used to play, too. Akin. I saw his grave.
This other, whatchacob, Ned, is, uh, Vig Gasper? Oh, yeah, Vig Gasper. Oh, yeah, yeah. Vig Gasper, yeah. Vig Gasper. Remember anybody named Baptiste? Oh, oh, oh, that, that... Baptiste.
